biggest_catch: This is a LOAN referral: you only earn the $50 when your friend actually closes on and funds a loan of at least $5,000 with a minimum 24-month term (and opens the $5 Share Savings). Referring someone who only inquires or is declined earns you nothing.
catches: Referred friend must become a new member (establish Share Savings with $5) and close on a funded loan of at least $5,000 with a minimum term of 24 months.
Bonus is granted per new member/borrower, not per loan — you cannot stack multiple $50 bonuses from the same friend's loans.
$50 bonus paid within two weeks of loan funding.
The referral bonus to the existing (referring) member may be subject to tax reporting for amounts in excess of $600.
No stated limit on the number of referrals. evergreenDIRECT Credit Union may cancel the promotion at any time without prior notice.

steps: Complete the referral coupon with your member name, address, and cell number.
Share the coupon with a friend, family member, or coworker.
Your friend becomes a new evergreenDIRECT member (opens $5 Share Savings) and applies for a loan.
Your friend closes on a funded loan of at least $5,000 with a minimum 24-month term.
Your $50 bonus is paid within two weeks of loan funding.
timing: Bonus $50 paid within two weeks of loan funding.
